units.source_text: 能聽到靜子那低聲發自內心的幸福歡笑。

en.t: I could hear Shizuko's low, heartfelt laughter of happiness.

units.source_text: 我把門輕輕推開一條小縫，往裡一瞧，是一隻小白兔，

en.t: I gently pushed the door open a crack and peered inside; there was a little white rabbit,

units.source_text: 在房間裡活蹦亂跳，母女倆正追著它玩。

en.t: hopping about the room, while mother and daughter chased after it in play.
(How happy they are, the two of them.

units.source_text: 像我這樣的混蛋夾在她們中間，遲早有一天會毀了她們。

en.t: A bastard like me, wedged between them, will sooner or later destroy them.

units.source_text: 啊，倘若神能聽到我這種人的祈求，就算只有一次，一生中哪怕只有一次也行，神啊，我祈求您賜予她們幸福。）

en.t: Ah, if God could hear the prayers of someone like me, even just once, even just once in my whole life would be enough. God, I pray that You grant them happiness.)

units.source_text: 我真想原地蹲下，合掌祈禱。

en.t: I truly wanted to crouch down right there and pray with my hands together.

units.source_text: 我輕輕地掩上房門，又返回銀座，

en.t: I quietly closed the door again and went back to Ginza,

units.source_text: 從此再也沒踏進過公寓的門。

en.t: and from then on I never again set foot inside the apartment.
